title: Metropolitan France Vigilance
scenario: Read Météo-France warnings for a viewed coordinate on server1. These examples use an actual local HTTP replay of the issuer snapshot from November 20, 2026, captured at its original validity time.

steps.title: Read a timed department advisory
steps.instruction: With Vigilance enabled on server1, request GET /weather/v000903/coord/48.85661,2.3522/warnings. Check the department code, issuer and timing fields before displaying the advisory.
steps.caption: Paris, department 75. The issuer's yellow wind interval ends at 16:00 UTC.
steps.expected: Show Météo-France and its original warning period. Display a future onset as upcoming and remove an interval when it expires.

steps.title: Read a successful clear result
steps.instruction: Request GET /weather/v000903/coord/45.764,4.8357/warnings. Use sources.state together with the warnings list.
steps.caption: Lyon, department 69. Current coverage has no advisories in the replay.
steps.expected: Interpret an empty list as clear only when the source state is current. Unsupported and unavailable states can also have empty warning arrays.
